title: Empanadas Argentina
description: Delicious Argentinian-style empanadas filled with gooey cheese and a hint of Latin spice.

ingredients.name: Yeasty
ingredients.notes: 1 teaspoon sugar and 1 cup warm water

ingredients.name: Gooey
ingredients.amount: 1 cup shredded cheese (Monterey Jack or Cheddar)

instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine cornmeal, yeast, sugar, and warm water. Let it sit for 5-7 minutes until yeast is activated.
2. Add cumin, cayenne pepper, and salt to the bowl. Mix well.
3. Add gooey cheese to the bowl and mix until well combined.
4. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
5. Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
6. Roll each piece into a ball and flatten it slightly into a disk.
7. Place a tablespoon of cheese in the center of each disk.
8. Fold the dough in half and press the edges to seal.
9. Brush the tops with beaten egg for a golden glaze.
10. Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
